verdict.rationale: Angular's source is publicly hosted at github.com/angular/angular, which shows the code can be read. Nothing in the evidence names the license or confirms it is an open-source license, so the 'open license' half of the story is unverified. Missing for 10: explicit license identification (e.g. a LICENSE file or an OSI-approved license statement), and independent corroboration of open-source licensing terms.
